data.one_liner: A widget that applies a tap-triggered smooth scale and tilt animation to children.
data.what_it_does: The Bounce widget wraps a target widget to add a touch-triggered scale and rotate animation. Depending on the touch location, a tilt effect is applied, which can be customized or disabled.
use_when: You want to add tactile feedback animations to buttons or clickable widgets.
You need a bounce or tilt effect based on where the user taps a widget.
avoid_when: You need complex physics-based motion suites or timelines like Rive or Lottie.
Targeting Safari iOS where specific filter quality adjustments are needed manually.
strengths: Configurable tilt angle, scale factor, and tap delay
Supports secondary tap and long press callbacks
weaknesses: Requires manual filter quality adjustment on Safari iOS due to browser limitations
Limited to scale and tilt bounce effects

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a comprehensive set of general-purpose animations and effects rather than just tap-triggered bouncing.
